cues: Sometimes the tense does not shift.
When the reporting verb is in the present or future: he says that he is busy.
With universal truths and permanent facts: the teacher said that the earth revolves round the sun.
With unreal clauses, second and third conditionals and wishes, which are already unreal: he said that if he were rich, he would travel.
And with a past tied to a stated past time: he said he was born in two thousand and five.
